notes.title: Patch 1.3.1 - Post-Update Hotfixes
notes.notes:
After some feedback with the previous update, we've made some hotfixes.



Also, Astral Throne will be a part of a Steam Daily Deal today (Sunday, Sept 14) starting at 1PM Eastern. 

So if you're thinking of buying the game now, wait just a little bit! You won't regret it!


Patch Notes 1.3.1


Gameplay Tweaks

Story is now enabled by default for Custom Games, for those who want to experience storylines with custom game rules

However, there is a new warning added to the Custom Games page: Warning: If you deploy too many Heroes, story scenes might not play in the proper sequence.

You can still turn the story off whenever you want during Custom Games like before



Bug Fixes

Fixed issues where the wrong kinds of Encounters will be chosen from the Encounter pool

Fixed problem where you could be rewarded with two of the same Memory at the same time

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - Map Content Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to Astral Throne's third content update!

We’re fleshing out the Encounter pool with new maps, story scenes, and mechanics.


Patch Notes 1.3.0

New Encounters


Act 1

New Chapter 1 Skirmish: Bella Marina

New Skirmish: Bosco Workshop

New Skirmish: Drivasto Ospedale

New Battle: Ambush!



Act 2

New Skirmish: Ring Around the Moatsy

New Skirmish: Empoisonne Swamp

New Battle: Ordinator of the Vault


Gameplay Additions
Cetus’s Teleportals no longer have cooldowns

Added a Custom Game option to turn off the Campaign (Run) Time Limit, so you can spend as long as you want in acts

If this option is turned on, empty Encounters in the World Map will no longer turn into Skirmishes after a couple moves


Bugs Fixed
Forcefields and Teleporters are more clearly on/off or on cooldown

Fixed issue where Forcefield and Teleporter states would not properly save and load

Recruitable Militia Hetja can no longer spawn more than once in a run

Consumables used from the Caravan from Units with a full inventory will no longer refuse to discard themselves after exhausting their stacks

Optimized Stardust visual effect

Adjusted some UI elements



If this feels a little underwhelming, don’t worry, we have some big news coming in the next couple months! Stay tuned…

notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 - Hetja’s Quest Collab!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! To celebrate the Summer Sale, we’re doing a collaboration with the Fire Emblem Romhack community. Namely, an actual Fire Emblem Roguelike: Hetja’s Quest!



Hetja has been added to the game as a Recruitable Militia. They have the special skill of being able to spawn as any class.



In turn, Lyra will be added as a playable character in the next Hetja’s Quest update some time soon.



Check it out here: https://www.dandelionhands.com/hetjasquest/

And share some love: https://feuniverse.us/t/fe8-hetjas-quest-v0-8-01-01/20622


Patch Notes 1.2.5
- Added new Militia “Hetja”

- …That’s it



As for the next major Astral Throne update, we hit some development snags so it’s coming along a little slower than expected. We still expect to release the map content update this Summer, though.



We’ve also been hard at work at something we can’t share any details about just yet, but we’ll let you all know some time after the Summer Content Update.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.4 - Bug Fixes and Gameplay Tweaks

Patch Notes 1.2.3

Bugs Fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2 - Balance Tweaks
notes.notes:
In 1.1, we tried to smooth out the difficulty curve so you weren't cruising through Acts 2 and 3 if you managed to make it through Act 1. We overcompensated a bit and made the game too frustrating in turn, as that ended up cranking up the difficulty of the whole game too much. This patch is meant to undo a lot of the frustration that caused. And while the curve has hopefully smoothed out a bit, we're still working on improving it, but first we're going to bring the difficulty of the whole game down, making it easier overall.

Balance Changes
 Slightly reduced stats of all enemies in Acts 2 and 3
 Slightly reduced generic enemy growth rates
 Adjusted Final Boss to only gain +2 stat per remaining Ordinator while on the highest difficulty level
 Reduced the ATS threshold for doubling to 4 from 5
 Gave the "Thomas" Militia -2 MOV when on the enemy team, and made him guaranteed to spawn with a Sublcass and 2 Items
 Reduced the bonus range of the long range Ordinator from +7 to +5 in the "Star of Montes Luna" encounter
 Removed several of the Enemies from the starting area of the "Star of Montes Luna" encounter
 Removed some reinforcements from the "Star of Montes Luna" encounter

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Spring Content Update
notes.notes:
Welcome to the second content update! This one doubles (yes, doubles) the number of Recruitable Militia Units and makes each Militia stand out from each other a little more. 

Patch Notes 1.2.0

New Recruitable Militia Units

 2 new Adepts
 3 new Druids
 2 new Knights
 3 new Mages
 3 new Monks
 3 new Scholars
 2 new Scouts
 2 new Warriors

Militia Changes

 Existing Militia’s stats have been rebalanced to make them stand out from one another more
 Each of the new Militia (and a few existing ones) now start with a skill that they’ll have every time they spawn
 Most of these skills are special and unique, but not all 
 Skill books contains some of these new Skills

Bug Fixes and Tweaks

 Fixed the World Map sometimes pointing itself in weird places when opening it
 Fixed issues with Cetus’s Teleportals and removed their cooldowns
 Fixed convoy filters sometimes switching while grabbing items
 Fixed “Learn By Example” Skill from locking up the game occasionally
 Fixed “Smokescreen” Status Effect from being removed after moving 0 tiles
 UI tweaks and improvements
 Recruitable Militia that spawn in Act 2 start with more experience
 Adjusted the base stats and growths of all classes
 Reduced impact of difficulty levels that reduce experience and HP
 Maia now starts 3 levels lower than the other Heroes so she can gain more experience quickly
 “Requisition” Skill now has a 50% chance of granting an Uncommon Weapon or better instead of 40%
 Reduced MOV of Starblind in the “Colline Royal Park” and “Manoir du Flambeur” skirmish encounters in Act 2
 Reduced difficulty of “Stargazer Temple” and “Imperial Cemetery” skirmish encounters in Act 2
 Halved the damage of the Stardust in the “Imperial Cemetery” encounter
 Reduced difficulty of the “Star of Montes Luna” encounter
 Final Boss gains +1 to each stat for each remaining Ordinator instead of +2


Fan Wiki
The Astral Throne community has also started a fan wiki! Feel free to contribute to it. It’s gonna need some work after this update. Check it out here: https://astralthrone.wiki.gg/

We are of course still working on fixing bugs and balancing the encounters. We’ve received some great feedback on the previous balance update so look forward to more balance updates soon.

In case you missed it, here’s what was added in Patch 1.1.0, the previous update:

 Encounter balance changes to smooth difficulty curve, but more balance changes are on the way
 Knights got a new Skillset to improve their utility, with their old skills moved to the General Skillset
 Similar changes were made to the Battlemage, with Lyra gaining a new starting Skill
 QoL features such as sort and auto-heal buttons in the Caravan

You can read more about it here.

And if it's been a while since you've played, we've also fixed a lot of bugs and made the game a lot more stable since release!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - First Content Update
notes.notes:
Here's Astral Throne's first content update. There will be more where this came from soon, so stay tuned.

Patch Notes 1.1.0

Class Changes

 Added NEW Skills to the Knight Skill Set: “Boneshaker”, “Cavalier”, and “Charge Through”
 Added NEW Skills to the Battlemage Skill Set: “Cavalier”, “Charge Through”, and “Power Convergence”
 Added NEW Skills to the General Skill Set: “Sitting Duck” and “Learn By Example”
 Moved old Knight and Battlemage Skills to the General Skill Set: “Unimpeded”, “Little Off the Top”, and “Turtle”
 Lyra’s starting Leader Skill is now “Power Convergence”

Balance Changes
Units and Skills

 Increased base HIT for every Unit by 5
 DEX and SPD grant 3 HIT and AVO instead of 4
 “Bless Land” Skill no longer costs Gold to cast
 “Sharpshooter” Skill no longer grants ATS
 “Aegis” Status Effect grants 2 ATS instead of 3
 Leaders and Secondary Heroes start with more Exp
 Stat Growth Rate Skills give 25% more growth instead of 15%

Encounters

 Reduced difficulty of Chapter 1 Skirmishes of Act 1
 Increased difficulty of Act 1 Skirmith “Drivasto Outskirts”
 Reduced difficulty of Act 1 Battle “Ordinator of the Market”
 Increased difficulty of Act 1 Battle “Ordinator of the Plateau”
 Rearranged locations of Enemy reinforcements on Act 1 Battle “Ordinator of the Bridge”
 Reduced difficulty of Act 2 Skirmish “Empire Borderlands”
 Reduced difficulty of Act 2 Battle “Ordinator of the Archives”
 Increased difficulty of every other Act 2 Encounter, aside from “Mont Frontiere”
 Increased difficulty of Act 3 Siege “The Star of Montes Luna”

We want to address the inertia people get, where you either die on Act 1 or make it to the end of the game, so this won’t be the only balance update, of course.

QoL

 Added an auto-heal button to the Caravan that heals all your Units
 Added a button to the Caravan that sorts its items
 Added a button to the Caravan that sorts your Units
 Item filters in the Caravan have been expanded and reorganized a bit
 Added a setting that allows the game to be run in the background
 Added a setting that turns on/off the dialogue beeps and boops
 While targeting an attack or skill, limited the tile selection to the target area to smooth out the process of selecting targets

Bug Fixes

 Optimized the game a bit, framerate should improve across the board
 Combat camera no longer moves outside of walls of certain interior-based Encounters
 Attempted to fix certain instances of certain events removing odd amounts of stacks of items
 Fixed some dialogue scenes
 Fixed certain character pair endings and their respective achievements from getting mixed up when triggering
 Fixed Weapon Skills “Unyielding”, “Impale”, and “Code Switch” not stacking
 Fixed problems with skills that change the ATS threshold to gain a bonus attack
 Fixed certain things not appearing in the Codex
 Fixed weapon models being strangely big and misplaced on Marionette


Please also look forward to another content update coming out in April! That one will focus on expanding the Militia.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 + Rough Content Update Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Another day, another patch.

Patch Notes 1.0.9

 Fixed Encounters sometimes appearing more than once in a run
 Fixed certain status effects on tiles not saving, e.g. “Static Cling” during the Ordinator of the Bridge Encounter
 Fixed Skill Books in Crossroads Events sometimes showing a different skill before and after you take them
 Fixed the buttons on the bottom left of the screen not activating during the dialogue sequence when beating an Encounter during Enemy Phase
 Added descriptions to Terraform skills that detail the Tile type they transform tiles into
 Minor UI tweaks and fixes


This should be the last 1.0.X patch… As we’re going to start putting out content updates!
Thanks to all your feedback, we have a good idea on what to focus on for Astral Throne’s future.

The update schedule will be a little variable, but here are our current plans for full transparency:


Rough Content Update Roadmap

1.1.0: In a week or two

 Knight and Battlemage class reworks
 Encounter Balancing
 QoL features


1.2.0: Late March/Early April

 New Recruitable Militia Units
 Rework Militia a bit to make them feel more unique


1.3.0: Early Summer

 A lot of new Encounters in Acts 1 and 2
 These Encounters will be spread amongst each of the Encounter types: Skirmishes, Battles, and Sieges



Updates after this will depend on further feedback, as well as how much money Astral Throne is continuing to make so we can sustain development. 

Currently, we have these subsequent updates in mind, but they’re subject to change:

 Adding more variety and skills to Hero Units
 Adding even more variety to maps
 Improving random events

Fixed instances of dialogue scenes not starting properly sometimes
Fixed crashing issue when pressing “Next Unit” immediately as the player phase starts
Fixed controller binds not saving sometimes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4: The Big Fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we’re really sorry that some of you ran into problems with saving and loading your game mid-run. With the runs being as long as they are, it is incredibly important that they work properly. Truth be told, this proved to be a more complicated issue than we were expecting. This feature was working for us devs and beta playtesters, so we were surprised to see some people having terrible issues with it. We are truly sorry about that and we thank you so much for your patience these last few days.

So, we hunkered down and rewrote the saving and loading system. It’s now way more stable and less sensitive to error. Some playtesters in the community have even claimed it has fixed previously softlocked save files. We’d like to believe the problem has been solved now, but we’d still like crash reports if they happen.

Thank you so much for your support!


Of course, that’s not the only thing this patch fixes.

Patch Notes 1.0.4
Big Fixes

 Fixed issues with save corruption
 Fixed issue where the difficulty level would sometimes not load properly mid-run
 Fixing crashing occasionally after getting a random event (“!”) on the world map between encounters
 Fixed getting weirdly low framerate sometimes
 Attempted to fix occasionally not finishing an Encounter after completing its objective


Other Fixes

 Fixed issue where having multiple Send-Item-To-Caravan menus in a row would softlock the game
 Fixed issues with swapping mounts in the Caravan
 Fixed not being able to close certain locked tooltips
 Fixed the red outlines that occasionally appears on player units
 Fixed Memories that change a stat during a certain phase that were applying to enemies
 Fixed “Mindfulness” Memory not healing units to full
 Fixed Maia’s mounted animations
 Fixed Marionette not getting automatically removed from the encounter when dying during Player Phase
 Fixed Marionette not getting put the Caravan at the end of an Encounter if Maia's inventory is full
 Fixed issues with Aniara’s “Transfusion” skill
 Fixed a very rare case where one of the three skills at level-up would not appear
 Fixed “Sell” button in shop not appearing sometimes
 Fixed being able to close the Caravan menu while in shop sometimes
 Attempted to fix camera being close to the ground sometimes (if this ever happens to you, just try playing normally, it should fix itself)
 Unaligned reinforcements now have a differently coloured reinforcement warning (white instead of red)
 Unchecking edge panning in the control settings allows your cursor to leave the window
 Minor graphical and UI tweaks


Balance Changes

 Draco’s “Wager” now grants 1 Chip per successful roll instead of 2
 Draco’s “Gentleman’s Game” now grants 2 stacks of “Wager” instead of 1 and its cooldown has increased from 3 to 4
 Draco’s “Strike a Bet” now grants 2 stacks of “Wager” instead of 1
 Draco’s “High Stakes” now loses 2 Chips per unsuccessful roll instead of 1
 The Marionette item is now destroyable, and destroying the item will remove Marionette as a Unit from your team
 Final boss’s “Saprophyte” skill now grants +2 bonus to each stat instead of +1
 Tweaked encounters you could get in Act 3



We’re still working on these issues:

 Improving Knight and Battlemage-type Units
 Balancing Encounter difficulty
 Adding a sort button the caravan
 Fixing the music not resuming properly when loading the game sometimes
 Very rarely when Saving a downed unit, then quitting and loading again will cause the game to think that unit is still around in a weird (but not game-breaking) way
 Some of you just can’t control the game at all. This is a tough one, but we’re working on it

notes.title: Bugfix Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. We sincerely apologize for the save game issues that have been plaguing some of you.
We’re trying the best we can to address them, and it’s hopefully coming to a close soon.

Patch 1.0.3 Notes


 Attempted to fix an issue where difficulty levels were not loaded properly
 Fixed an issue where sometimes you could get the same encounter more than once in a run
 Fixed an issue where upon load, the music might not resume properly
 Fixed a possible issue where the main menu on the title screen would not open
 Fixed an issue where the “Kingmaker” achievement would not trigger
 Added the option to send your error logs directly upon failure to load save file


So, instead of seeing an unhelpful “💀 Dang” as the only button, you see this:
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1172611761791320145/1338200003872686080/image.png?ex=67aa375f&is=67a8e5df&hm=9236a00cdf9e24f16fbeeeb11c4bcd3f91b7708e6880dfc0729189e50e7b87b9&=&format=webp&quality=lossless

Though we might still ask you to send your log files from time to time.

And if your difficulty level doesn’t load properly, you’ll see this icon:
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1172611761791320145/1338200105676967966/image.png?ex=67aa3777&is=67a8e5f7&hm=2f5ba4780e9b06a7eb35f2a6e1039426cb7385982e172fe797db9c2ea9865dd3&=&format=webp&quality=lossless
So let us know if you do.
When loading, it might be that icon for a second or two, and then pop to its proper icon if it was able to properly load the difficulty. So don’t be alarmed if it’s like that for a second.



This (and future) patches should not corrupt your run save. If your run save is corrupted, please let us know. You can post on the forum, join our discord or email to us: info@zerosungames.com
Your report will be extra helpful if you include:
The version number (on the bottom right of the title screen)
A screenshot (or even a video recording if you can manage)
What was going on at the time (e.g. enemy phase, in the world map, etc)
What actions you were doing (e.g. hitting the end phase button, initiating combat, etc)


If you want to be really helpful, you could go into C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\Zero Sun Games\Astral Throne and attach the “Player.log” file to your message.
And if you want to be extra extra helpful, if you haven't started a new game yet, you could zip up that entire save folder and send it to us.

Thank you!

notes.title: Release Delayed to Early 2025
notes.notes:
Hello!

Earlier this year we claimed that Astral Throne would be releasing toward the end of the year. Well, we’re approaching the end of the year and we realize we need a liiiitle more time to bring everything together.

So, we’re delaying the release of the game until Q1 2025. Really just a couple months from our initial planned release. We’ll share the exact date some time later.

Thanks for your patience,

Zero Sun Games

Update Notes for 0.6.0:

New Content

Around 100 new weapons, each of them come with a new weapon skill!
4 new difficulties, unlock them by beating Act 1 once

Shops

You can now sell in shops!
Items sell for 10% of their value
The value of an item changes depending on how many stacks it has

Saving and Loading

Saving and loading now saves wherever you are and loads exactly where you left off, instead of at the beginning of your last encounter
The game auto-saves constantly 
Saving no longer causes the game to freeze for a moment or stutter

UI and QoL

The main menu has been overhauled to look a lot nicer
All valid weapon skills show up in a unit’s skill menu, even if you don’t have the weapon equipped. Using the skill equips the weapon
Recruiting another hero at the end of the first act now lets you choose their skills
The loading screen no longer stutters

Additionally, we spun off our new Demo page for the Beta. Please leave a review to let us know how you feel about it! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2573790/Astral_Throne_Beta/

Update Notes for 0.5.0:

New World Map

We felt the old, linear World Map wasn't working as well as we hoped, so we opened it up.
The new World Map is less linear and gives you a lot more choice in the path you want to take through the Acts. A new tutorial sequence should tell you everything you need to know.

New Encounters

The "Merchant" encounter has been removed
Added a new "Blacksmith" shop encounter, to buy physical weapons, land mounts, consumables, and memories
Added a new "Atelier" shop encounter, to buy magical weapons, flying mounts, consumables, and memories
Added a new "Alchemist" shop encounter, to transmute items into new items
Added a new "Trainer" encounter, where you can buy stat and class-changing items
Added a new "Treasure" encounter, where you get 1-4 pieces of loot
Added a food item to "Campfire" encounters, and moved the story sequence to after the end of the Act
Added a new "Arena" combat encounter, explained below


Subclasses

Units (both friend and foe) can be given a subclass based on any of the game's classes. Subclasses come with changes to a Unit's stats, growths, and available skill sets. 
You can buy subclass items for your Units at Trainers, and some enemies can have subclasses of their own.

The Arena

A new encounter has been added to the World Map: The Arena. 
In The Arena, you can choose between a nonlethal sparring match or a battle to the death for extra rewards. The only catch is that Hero Units can't fight, you must only use your Militia.

Combat Encounter Randomization

Combat encounters have some new randomization applied to them.
Some enemies' classes, weapons, items, and loot can change between runs, but not everyone.
Recruitable Militia can also be found in more spots in encounters as well.

Random Events

"?" encounters have been removed from the game. Instead, travelling between encounters can have you run into a random event. These come in 4 types:

[olist]
Loot Events, which can hand your team items or memories.
Status Events, which can bless team members with buffs or inflict debuffs on them
Crossroad Events, which can present a small list of choices that have costs, bonuses, or both
Story Events, which present a small story vignette and offers choices that have both story and gameplay effects
[/olist]

Story

The game's story has been entirely rewritten. It is now longer and contains more opportunities for branches. The new World Map has changed the story format, and the conversation your team has around the campfire has been moved to after finishing the Act.
Incidents that change the story of the run have become more obvious, and each Militia Unit now has a little story associated with them.

Misc.

More skills, memories, and status effects
Shop-style encounters now take place in a 3D environment instead of just a menu
Rebalance due to the world map changes and encounter randomization
Units have more story info in their Status menu
Bug fixes
Polish


Next Update will be for the Next Fest in October, see you there!

notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.notes:
As announced at the expo, Astral Throne's Beta has received a big update. Check out the patch notes below:

Update Notes for 0.4.0:

Unit Skills

 65 more skills!!
 Instead of having every Unit have access to every skill, units can now only access skills that are related to their class and weapon styles
 For example, Vega is a “Doctor” and is capable of using “Light Weapons” at the start, so he has access to Doctor and Light Weapon skills and can gain access to Projectile Weapon skills once he gains proficiency in them
 Everyone has access to the skill sets of “General”, “Attribute”, and “Support”
 General  skills are like the skills of the previous demo, fairly simple and basic
 Attribute skills raise and lower the Units’s stats
 Support skills grant bonuses when that Unit is close to another Unit of a particular class (e.g. raised STR when close to Warriors)
 You can see what skill sets a Unit has access to in their Status menu


UI

 Overhauled visual effects and animation on the UI
 Increased stability and reduced jank
 Improved aesthetics of world map and victory/defeat screens
 You now must “claim” loot at the end of an encounter to receive it
 Shortened skill and item descriptions, with more info put into locking their tooltip windows
 A new tutorial sequence for teaching about “locking” tooltip windows to better communicate them


General

 Many bug fixes
 2 New difficulties: “Easy” and “Veteran”
 Support for resolutions with aspect ratios other than 16:9 (e.g. Steam Deck, Ultrawide)
 Camera gets out of the way of structures during combat animations
 A general rebalance of stats, weapons, skills, and experience rates
 New settings, including disabling combat animations, managing screen shake, and if you want the game to confirm you ending your own phase
 Improved feeling of using skills and opening chests, you’ll see ;)


Next Update, we plan include:

 Changes to the world map and events
 Changes to militia recruitment
 Changes to the format of the story and improvements to the writing
